parts.html: The K-08 kitchen model combines warm brown tones, natural-looking wood textures, and streamlined minimalist design to create a welcoming contemporary kitchen interior.
Its single-wall configuration provides a clean architectural arrangement, making the model suitable for modern apartments, compact living spaces, and private residences.

The wood-effect finish introduces the visual warmth of timber while maintaining the understated character of minimalist furniture. Brown cabinet surfaces complement neutral walls, stone textures, light flooring, and contemporary interior materials.

One of the defining features of the K-08 model is its consistent use of HPL panels on an MDF substrate for both upper and lower cabinet fronts. The coordinated wood-effect decor creates a cohesive composition across the entire kitchen.
With a total linear length of 4.2 meters, the kitchen offers practical cabinet storage, an organized work surface, and integrated appliance placement without requiring a separate island.
The countertop uses a chipboard-based material, while the main cabinet construction features 18 mm laminated particleboard.
For everyday convenience, the upper cabinets incorporate FREE SPACE Hafele lift mechanisms, providing comfortable access to overhead storage.
Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges and Muller Box Profi Line drawer systems complete the functional hardware configuration.
Cabinet handles are included, while pull-out cargo storage is not part of the standard model.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for residential interiors in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-08 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural requirements, built-in appliance specifications, and storage preferences.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, furniture manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
